_metadata.description: Standard vocabulary concept ID cross-references for GxP clinical and genomic normalisation
_metadata.author: Vivi Tsoumaki

icd10_to_snomed._description: ICD-10-CM clinical diagnosis codes mapped to standard SNOMED CT concept IDs (CONDITION_OCCURRENCE.condition_concept_id)
icd10_to_snomed._comment_E11.9: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications -> SNOMED 201826
icd10_to_snomed._comment_C34.90: Malignant neoplasm of unspecified part of bronchus/lung -> SNOMED 254637

loinc_to_concept._description: LOINC laboratory biomarker observation codes mapped to OMOP Measurement standard concepts (MEASUREMENT.measurement_concept_id)
loinc_to_concept._comment_4548-4: Hemoglobin A1c / HbA1c in Blood Panel -> OMOP Concept 3004410
loinc_to_concept._comment_2345-7: Glucose in Serum or Plasma -> OMOP Concept 3000483
loinc_to_concept._comment_2093-3: Cholesterol in Serum or Plasma -> OMOP Concept 3004249
loinc_to_concept._comment_2160-0: Creatinine in Serum or Plasma -> OMOP Concept 3016723
loinc_to_concept._comment_33959-8: Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) in Serum or Plasma -> OMOP Concept 3006923

gender_to_concept._description: Gender source strings normalized and mapped to OMOP Gender concepts (PERSON.gender_concept_id)

race_to_concept._description: Race source strings mapped to OMOP Race concepts (PERSON.race_concept_id)

ethnicity_to_concept._description: Ethnicity source strings mapped to OMOP Ethnicity concepts (PERSON.ethnicity_concept_id)

clinvar_to_concept._description: ClinVar CLNSIG variant annotations mapped to OMOP Meas Value standard concepts (MEASUREMENT.value_as_concept_id)
